messages.subject: MSstaat for phosphoproteomics
parts:
Hello!

I recently started analyzing phosphoproteomic data from a collaboration.
I was wondering if MSstats is the right tool for us. Few details below.

Platform: Ti4+ IMAC + LC-MS/MS
Labeling: stable isotope dimethyl with 3 labels (Heavy/Medium/Light)

I have intensity values and additional information exported from Proteome Discoverer, and in this pilot phase, we have three conditions and three biological replicates.

I would appreciate your help.

all my best

Francesco

Dear Francesco,

Sorry for not answering sooner. I am not familiar with this type of labeling. I asked my colleagues but they were not familiar either. Could you please provide more details? In particular, does the quantification occur at the MS1 or the MS2 level? Is it full scan?

Thank you in advance
Olga
